question: For each department where the total number of organizations associated with that department whose parent is 'EXECVP' or 'CHNCLR' is greater than 5, give the department name, the total number of organizations, the DLC name, the average organization number, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for assignable organizations associated with that DLC, and the HR organization unit title, ordering the results by the total number of organizations in descending order and then by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_organizations, da.DLC_NAME, da.avg_org_number, da.org_number_stddev, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME ) da ON f.DLC_NAME = da.DLC_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_organizations DESC, da.org_number_stddev DESC;
column_mapping: {"department": ["HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME"], "total number of organizations": ["FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY"], "organizations associated with that department": ["FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY", "HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME"], "parent is 'EXECVP' or 'CHNCLR'": ["FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORG_PARENT"], "department name": ["HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME"], "DLC name": ["FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME"], "average organization number": ["FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER"], "standard deviation of the organization numbers": ["FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER"], "assignable organizations": ["FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE"], "HR organization unit title": ["HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE"]}
sub_questions: ["For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of organizations associated with that department for organizations whose parent is 'EXECVP' or 'CHNCLR', with the total number of organizations greater than 5.", "For each DLC, provide the DLC name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, considering only organizations that are assignable.", "For each department where the total number of organizations associated with that department whose parent is 'EXECVP' or 'CHNCLR' is greater than 5, give the department name, the total number of organizations, the DLC name, the average organization number, and the standard deviation of the organization numbers for assignable organizations associated with that DLC, ordering the results by the total number of organizations in descending order and then by the standard deviation of the organization numbers in descending order."]
sub_sqls: ["SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) > 5;", "SELECT o.DLC_NAME, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC;", "WITH DepartmentOrganizationCounts AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) > 5 ), DLCAggregates AS ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC ) SELECT doc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, doc.total_organizations, da.DLC_NAME, da.avg_org_number, da.org_number_stddev FROM DepartmentOrganizationCounts doc JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON doc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN DLCAggregates da ON f.DLC_NAME = da.DLC_NAME ORDER BY doc.total_organizations DESC, da.org_number_stddev DESC;"]
